assumptions: Each sheet has a fixed initial loading direction H or V; retained HIGH material never rotates at any level.
Far edge is sized after the work strips, preserving raw stock for the saw kerf.
Terminal edge sizing may overhang a detached blank; its single finished output cannot be machined again.
Clamp, stroke, feed and trim-overhang capability of the actual machine are not confirmed.
